sources.entry: MeTube - Web GUI for youtube-dl, with playlist support. Allows downloading videos from dozens of websites. AGPL-3.0 Python/Nodejs/Docker
MeTube | Web GUI for yt-dlp with playlist support

summary.one_liner: MeTube is a self-hosted web UI for yt-dlp that downloads videos, audio, subtitles and thumbnails from YouTube and hundreds of other sites to your server.
summary.what_it_does: MeTube accepts links from YouTube and many other sites, then downloads single videos, whole playlists or entire channels to the server. It supports subscriptions to channels and playlists that queue new uploads automatically. Quality, format and folder can be chosen per download, and server-wide yt-dlp options and named presets can be set through environment variables. Filenames are controlled by yt-dlp output templates, with separate templates for playlist and channel items. Configuration covers concurrency limits, download and temp directories, HTTPS, reverse-proxy URL prefixes and CORS for browser extensions.
use_cases: download YouTube videos to a home server
automatically grab new channel uploads via subscriptions
run a web-based downloader behind a reverse proxy
how_to_run: Or use Docker Compose with the ghcr.io/alexta69/metube image, port 8081:8081 and a downloads volume
notable: Web GUI for yt-dlp with playlist and channel support
Subscriptions queue new uploads from channels and playlists automatically
Three levels of yt-dlp options: global, presets, and per-download overrides
Multi-arch Docker images (amd64/arm64) on GitHub Container Registry and Docker Hub
Nightly yt-dlp update option via YTDL_NIGHTLY_UPDATE_TIME
caveats: Per-download yt-dlp override field allows running commands in the container, so it is for trusted users only
Scope is limited to downloading; tagging and library management are left to other tools
Interrupted downloads cannot resume when TEMP_DIR is a RAM disk
